description: As a new reader, I want to register with my name and email, so that I can borrow books.
As a member, I want to search books by title, so that I can find what to borrow.
As a member, I want to borrow a book and know when it is due, so that I can read it at home.

summary: Return a book and pay late fees
description: As a member, I want to return books and see any late fee, so that my account stays clear.
As a member, I want to see the books I currently have, so that I know what to return.
